title: 才 vs 就 Step 6 · 才 or 就? The Big Sort
description: Early or late, only or already, as long as or only if, as soon as or only just — pick 才 or 就 (and mind the 了).

points.title: Picking 才 or 就
points.summary: Ask: sooner/easier (就) or later/harder (才)? Then check the pattern (只要…就, 只有…才, 一…就).
points.body:
And the 了 test: a past sentence ending in 了 usually wants 就, not 才.

**才 vs 就 at a glance**

| | 就 🐇 | 才 🐢 |
|---|---|---|
| time | earlier than expected: 六点**就**来了 | later than expected: 十点**才**来 |
| 了? | usually **with** 了 | **no** 了 at the end |
| amount | 三岁**就**会游泳了 (that young!) | **才**十岁 (only ten) |
| condition | **只要**…**就**… (as long as) | **只有**…**才**… (only if) |
| also | **一**…**就**… (as soon as) | **才** = only just: 我才知道 |

**Feel the speaker:** 就 = sooner, easier, already 🐇 · 才 = later, harder, only then 🐢
examples: I waited ages before he turned up.

points.title: Reading the speaker's feelings
points.summary: 才 and 就 tell you whether the speaker finds something early/late, much/little.
points.body:
- 都十点了，他**才**起床！ (that's late!)
- 他**才**二十岁**就**当了经理。 (so young — so early!)

**才 vs 就 at a glance**

| | 就 🐇 | 才 🐢 |
|---|---|---|
| time | earlier than expected: 六点**就**来了 | later than expected: 十点**才**来 |
| 了? | usually **with** 了 | **no** 了 at the end |
| amount | 三岁**就**会游泳了 (that young!) | **才**十岁 (only ten) |
| condition | **只要**…**就**… (as long as) | **只有**…**才**… (only if) |
| also | **一**…**就**… (as soon as) | **才** = only just: 我才知道 |

**Feel the speaker:** 就 = sooner, easier, already 🐇 · 才 = later, harder, only then 🐢
examples: He's only twenty and already a manager.

questions.prompt: The big sort, round 1: 才 or 就?
items: {他|tā}{很|hěn}{聪明|cōngming}，{老师|lǎoshī}{说|shuō}{一|yí}{遍|biàn}{他|tā}＿{懂|dǒng}{了|le}。
{我|wǒ}{学|xué}{了|le}{三|sān}{年|nián}{中文|Zhōngwén}，{现在|xiànzài}＿{能|néng}{看|kàn}{中文|Zhōngwén}{报纸|bàozhǐ}。
questions.explanation: Late, hard, only-if → **才**; early, easy, as-long-as, as-soon-as → **就**.
So young → **才**二十岁 + 就 (so early).
notes: 就二十岁就 doubles 就.
已经二十岁就 doesn't fit the 'so young' feeling.
都二十岁 = already 20 — not 'so young'.
questions.translation: He's only twenty and already a manager.
It's already eleven — why are you only getting up now?

questions.prompt: Which sentence shows the speaker thinks **ten minutes is quick**?
questions.translation: He finished in just ten minutes.

questions.prompt: {这么|zhème}{贵|guì}{的|de}{手机|shǒujī}，{你|nǐ}{一|yí}{个|ge}{月|yuè}（　）{弄|nòng}{丢|diū}{了|le}？
notes: 才 doesn't take 了 — and the speaker finds one month surprisingly short.
questions.translation: Such an expensive phone, and you lost it within a month?

questions.prompt: {你|nǐ}{看|kàn}，{我|wǒ}{说|shuō}{什么|shénme}{来|lái}{着|zhe}？{他|tā}（　）{不会|bú huì}{来|lái}。
questions.explanation: 就 also adds emphasis = 'precisely, just as I said'.
notes: 才不会来 = 'he certainly won't come' (defiant) — but here the speaker is confirming a prediction.
questions.translation: See, what did I say? He's not coming.
